title: Show HN: I wrote an email app that accepts only one sender per inbox
title_zh: Show HN：我开发了一款邮件应用，每个收件箱仅接受一位发件人

paragraphs.en: Infinite inboxes, so nobody ever gets your real address. Give every company its own — when one leaks, you delete it, not your life.
paragraphs.zh: 无限邮箱地址，这样没人能得到你的真实地址。 给每家公司分配一个专属地址——当一家泄露时，你只需删掉它，而不是删掉你的生活。

sents.en: Infinite inboxes, so nobody ever gets your real address.
sents.zh: 无限邮箱地址，这样没人能得到你的真实地址。

sents.en: Give every company its own — when one leaks, you delete it, not your life.
sents.zh: 给每家公司分配一个专属地址——当一家泄露时，你只需删掉它，而不是删掉你的生活。

paragraphs.en: Every account comes with permanent addresses that anyone can write to and that never expire. If one starts getting spam, delete it and make a new one.
paragraphs.zh: 每个账户都配有永久地址，任何人都可以向这些地址写信，且永远不会失效。 如果某个地址开始收到垃圾邮件，删除它并创建一个新地址即可。

sents.en: Every account comes with permanent addresses that anyone can write to and that never expire.
sents.zh: 每个账户都配有永久地址，任何人都可以向这些地址写信，且永远不会失效。

sents.en: If one starts getting spam, delete it and make a new one.
sents.zh: 如果某个地址开始收到垃圾邮件，删除它并创建一个新地址即可。

paragraphs.en: That works, but it's manual work. The solution? Three specialty inboxes, each for a different kind of sender:
paragraphs.zh: 这样可行，但需要手动操作。解决方案是什么呢？ 三个专用收件箱，每个收件箱对应一类不同的发件人：

sents.en: That works, but it's manual work. The solution?
sents.zh: 这样可行，但需要手动操作。解决方案是什么呢？

sents.en: Three specialty inboxes, each for a different kind of sender:
sents.zh: 三个专用收件箱，每个收件箱对应一类不同的发件人：

paragraphs.en: Give it to one company. Once they write, only their mail gets in, and you can let in more senders, up to five in all. Anyone else is turned away, so a sold or leaked list is worth nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 把它交给一家公司。 一旦他们写信，只有他们的邮件能进来，而且你可以让更多发件人进来，总共最多五人。 其他任何人都被拒之门外，因此被出售或泄露的名单毫无价值。

sents.en: Give it to one company.
sents.zh: 把它交给一家公司。

sents.en: Once they write, only their mail gets in, and you can let in more senders, up to five in all.
sents.zh: 一旦他们写信，只有他们的邮件能进来，而且你可以让更多发件人进来，总共最多五人。

sents.en: Anyone else is turned away, so a sold or leaked list is worth nothing.
sents.zh: 其他任何人都被拒之门外，因此被出售或泄露的名单毫无价值。

paragraphs.en: Set a lifetime — an hour for a download link, a month for a trial. When it's up the inbox turns mail away, and can wipe what it holds.
paragraphs.zh: 设置一个有效期——下载链接一小时，试用版一个月。 到期后收件箱会拒收邮件，并可以清除其中保存的内容。

sents.en: Set a lifetime — an hour for a download link, a month for a trial.
sents.zh: 设置一个有效期——下载链接一小时，试用版一个月。

sents.en: When it's up the inbox turns mail away, and can wipe what it holds.
sents.zh: 到期后收件箱会拒收邮件，并可以清除其中保存的内容。

paragraphs.en: Create a prefix once, like “maryann”. Then hand out variations of it, like maryann.vet or maryann-party. A new inbox is created the first time someone writes to one of them, locked to that sender at first.
paragraphs.zh: 先创建一个前缀，例如「maryann」。 然后分发它的各种变体，例如 maryann.vet 或 maryann-party。 当有人第一次向其中某个地址写信时，会创建一个新的收件箱，并且最初仅对该发件人锁定。

sents.en: Create a prefix once, like “maryann”.
sents.zh: 先创建一个前缀，例如「maryann」。

sents.en: Then hand out variations of it, like maryann.vet or maryann-party.
sents.zh: 然后分发它的各种变体，例如 maryann.vet 或 maryann-party。

sents.en: A new inbox is created the first time someone writes to one of them, locked to that sender at first.
sents.zh: 当有人第一次向其中某个地址写信时，会创建一个新的收件箱，并且最初仅对该发件人锁定。

paragraphs.en: * Limits are 100 messages per day in the Free plan and 1000 in Pro and Business. Limits subject to change.
paragraphs.zh: * 限制为免费版每天 100 条消息，专业版和商业版每天 1000 条。 限制可能会发生变化。

sents.en: * Limits are 100 messages per day in the Free plan and 1000 in Pro and Business.
sents.zh: * 限制为免费版每天 100 条消息，专业版和商业版每天 1000 条。

sents.en: Limits subject to change.
sents.zh: 限制可能会发生变化。

paragraphs.en: Connect Claude, Cursor or any assistant that speaks MCP, and hand it the inbox chores: a fresh address for a sign-up, the code that just arrived, every receipt from March. It gets only the permissions you give it.
paragraphs.zh: 连接 Claude、Cursor 或任何支持 MCP 的助手，把收件箱的琐事交给它：注册用的全新地址、刚收到的验证码、三月份的每一封收据。 它只会获得你授予它的权限。

sents.en: Connect Claude, Cursor or any assistant that speaks MCP, and hand it the inbox chores: a fresh address for a sign-up, the code that just arrived, every receipt from March.
sents.zh: 连接 Claude、Cursor 或任何支持 MCP 的助手，把收件箱的琐事交给它：注册用的全新地址、刚收到的验证码、三月份的每一封收据。

sents.en: It gets only the permissions you give it.
sents.zh: 它只会获得你授予它的权限。

paragraphs.en: Make me an address for the gym trial, and tell me the code they send.
paragraphs.zh: 帮我创建一个健身房试课的注册信息，并告诉我他们发送的验证码。

paragraphs.en: We don't sell it, we don't read it and we don't track you. You can export your entire dataset at any time, on any plan.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不出售它，不读取它，也不追踪你。 你可以随时导出全部数据，任何套餐均可。

sents.en: We don't sell it, we don't read it and we don't track you.
sents.zh: 我们不出售它，不读取它，也不追踪你。

sents.en: You can export your entire dataset at any time, on any plan.
sents.zh: 你可以随时导出全部数据，任何套餐均可。

paragraphs.en: How the three inbox types work together in one mailbox.
paragraphs.zh: 三种收件箱类型如何在同一个邮箱中协同工作。

paragraphs.en: Check out our documentation , or contact us and a real human will reply.
paragraphs.zh: 查看我们的文档，或联系我们，会有真人回复您。

paragraphs.en: Sign in with a Google or Apple account, a passkey, or a username and a password. With Google, Clova.Email receives only your email address, your name and your profile photo; with Apple, only your email address, or one Apple makes to hide yours, and your name if you choose to share it. The address is how we know it is you, and the name and photo fill in your profile, where you can change or remove them. We never use any of it for advertising, never sell it and never share it. The whole of it is in our privacy policy .
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Google 或 Apple 账户、通行密钥（passkey）或用户名和密码登录。 使用 Google 登录时，Clova.Email 只会收到你的电子邮箱地址、姓名和个人资料照片；使用 Apple 登录时，只会收到你的电子邮箱地址（或 Apple 生成的用于隐藏你真实地址的地址），以及你选择分享时的姓名。 邮箱地址是我们确认你身份的依据，姓名和照片则用于填写你的个人资料，你可以在其中更改或删除它们。 我们绝不会将这些信息用于广告，绝不会出售，也绝不会分享。 所有这些内容都载于我们的隐私政策 。

sents.en: Sign in with a Google or Apple account, a passkey, or a username and a password.
sents.zh: 使用 Google 或 Apple 账户、通行密钥（passkey）或用户名和密码登录。
